name: Peachtree City
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Peachtree City?
answer_short: Yes. Golf carts use the Peachtree City multi-use path network. The city ordinance bars carts from Hwy 74, Hwy 54, Peachtree Parkway and Crosstown Rd between Peachtree Parkway and Hwy 74, except at crossings. Street-legal LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

golf_cart.roads: Multi-use paths and city streets the ordinance allows
golf_cart.notes: Not on Hwy 74, Hwy 54 or Peachtree Pkwy

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Peachtree City?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Georgia LSV law. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Peachtree Parkway?
faq.a: No. The city ordinance bars carts from Peachtree Parkway except to cross it.

faq.q: Where can golf carts go in Peachtree City?
faq.a: On the city's multi-use path network and the streets the ordinance allows, crossing the big highways at the path tunnels and bridges.
